statements.status_notes: Jetty is present only as a transitive dependency of hadoop-common, via the iceberg-source plugin. Data Prepper references no org.eclipse.jetty class and never instantiates a Jetty Server or security handler; HTTP ingestion uses Armeria/Netty and the management API uses com.sun.net.httpserver. The vulnerable jetty-security code is never on an execute path.

No fixed version available for the 9.4.x branch. The Jetty 9.4.x line is EOL with the last release being 9.4.56.v20240826. Upstream Apache ZooKeeper 3.8.6 and 3.9.5 pin jetty.version=9.4.58.v20250814. Upgrading to a supported Jetty version (10.x, 11.x, or 12.x) would require migration to jakarta.servlet API, which is not currently validated for ZooKeeper's admin server.

The advisory identifies org.eclipse.jetty.client.util.DigestAuthentication as the vulnerable class. That class is provided by the jetty-client artifact, which is absent from the Cassandra Reaper image SBOM and bundled application JAR. The scanner-reported jetty-security artifact does not contain the vulnerable class; Cassandra Reaper uses Apache HttpClient 5 for its HTTP client functionality.
